data.action: 坐在横放的巨剑上晃腿
data.description: 【莱万汀 · 剑冢小憩】插满断裂武器的试炼场巨石之上，莱万汀大咧咧地坐在横放的宽刃巨剑上晃动着修长的双腿，尾巴在身后欢快地摆动。看到你走过来，她拍了拍身旁的剑身——「喂！管理员！站着不累吗？过来坐在这把大剑上，结实得很，绝对塌不了！」
data.promptProse: Laevatain sits on a broad greatsword laid across a trial-ground boulder, swinging her legs and patting the blade beside her to invite the Administrator to sit. Her black-to-crimson halter evening gown drapes over the stone, tail moving behind. The full-body view includes broken weapons planted farther away. Dusk cools the upper folds, while embers warm the sword edge and the gown's crimson lower fabric.
data.title: 莱万汀 · 剑冢小憩
